dct_description_sm: in situ data for the validation of satellite-derived water optical quality indicators in the Grande Rivire de la baleine, Nunavik. The data set includes: 1) water transparency as measured using secchi disk; 2) water color using the Forel-Ule color scale; 3) hyperspectral remote sensing reflectance measured using hand-held spectroradiometer.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Environment surveillance
dct_title_s: Surveillance de la qualit optique de l'eau en Arctique: une perspective inuite et satellitaire (INUKSAT)
